ja490:1.1: Appossukko dāni tuvaṃ kapoṭa, vihaṅgama na tava bhojanattho, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto kasmā bhavaṃ posathiko kapoṭo ti.
ja490:2.1: Ahaṃ pure giddhigato kapoṭiyā asmiṃ pakesasmiṃ ubho ramāma, ath' aggahī sākuṇiko kapoṭiṃ, akāmako tāya vinā ahosiṃ.
ja490:3.1: Nānābhavā vippayogena tassā manomayaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmi, tasmā ahaṃ posathaṃ pālayāmi, rāgo mamaṃ mā punar āgamāsīti.
ja490:4.1: Anujjugāmi uraga-ddujivha dāṭhāvudho ghoraviso si sappa, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto kasmā bhavaṃ posathiko nu dīgho.
ja490:5.1: Usabho ahū balavā gāmikassa calakkakū vaṇṇabalūpapanno, [so] maṃ akkamī, taṃ kupito aḍassiṃ, dukkhābhitunno maraṇaṃ upāgami.
ja490:6.1: Tato janā nikkhamitvāna gāmā kanditvā roditva upakkamiṃsu, tasmā ahaṃ posathaṃ pālayāmi, kodho mamaṃ mā punar āgamāsi.
ja490:7.1: Matāna maṃsāni bahū susāne, manuññarūpaṃ tava bhojan' etaṃ, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto kasmā bhavaṃ posathiko sigālo.
ja490:8.1: Pavissaṃ kucchiṃ mahato gajassa kuṇape rato hatthimaṃse pagiddho, uṇho ca vāto tikhiṇā ca rasmiyo te sosayuṃ tassa karīsamaggaṃ.
ja490:9.1: Kiso ca paṇḍū ca ahaṃ bhadante, na me ahuṃ nikkhamanāya maggo, mahā ca megho sahasā pavassi, so temayi tassa karīsamaggaṃ.
ja490:10.1: Tato ahaṃ nikkhamissaṃ bhadante Cando yathā Rāhumukhā pamutto, tasmā ahaṃ posathaṃ pālayāmi, lobho mamaṃ mā punar āgamāsi.
ja490:11.1: Vammīkathūpasmiṃ kipillikāni nippothayanto tuvaṃ pure carāsi, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto kasmā bhavaṃ posathiko nu accho.
ja490:12.1: Sakan niketaṃ atihīḷayano atricchatāya malataṃ agañchiṃ, tato janā nikkhamitvāna gāmā kodaṇḍakena paripothayiṃsu maṃ.
ja490:13.1: So bhinnasīso ruhirakkhitaṅgo paccāgamāsiṃ sakaṃ niketaṃ, tasmā ahaṃ posathaṃ pālayāmi, atricchatā mā punar āgamāsīti.
ja490:14.1: Yan no apucchittha tuvaṃ bhadante sabbe va vyākarimhā yathāpajānaṃ, mayam pi pucchāma tuvaṃ bhadante: kasmā bhavaṃ posathiko va brahme ti.
ja490:15.1: Anūpalitto mama assamamhi paccekabuddho muhuttaṃ nisīdi, so maṃ avedī gatiṃ āgatiñ ca nāmañ ca gottañ caraṇañ ca sabbaṃ.
ja490:16.1: Evam p' ahaṃ na-ggahe tassa pāde, na cāpi naṃ mānagatena pucchiṃ, tasmā ahaṃ posathaṃ pālayāmi, māno mamaṃ mā punar āgamāsīti.
